newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in May.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in May.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $62.15 million in the second half of May to $6,475 million, according to central bank figures published on Tuesday.
Gross reserves had risen $39.76 million in the first half of May to $6,413 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' net foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.

The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources said they stood at $4,800 million at the end of May. They stood at $4,015 million at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier.
